e.title: **一个**把结果先冻住**的理赔舞弊演示：**不现场重训模型，**而是**把已经验证过的数字端上来****：Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`——**⭐ 逐字**「**Instead of retraining on start-up, it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**明说**46 份调查简报里**有 2 份没通过人工评分标准**，**而那 2 份**照原分数显示、**不藏起来**（**逐字**「**the 2 that didn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t are shown with their real score, not hidden**」**）**；**⭐ 冻结基线逐字**「**no_skill_pr_auc**」**为 **0.0597**、**PR-AUC **0.1945**、**阈值 **0.15**、**抽查工时占比 **7.61%****；**⚠️ 而**本次**两次请求**得到**两种状态**：**先是**平台页「**Preparing Space**」**、**后是**真实应用页**（**逐字标题**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**）**——**⭐ 因其档位是**缩容到零**的 **`zero-a10g`****
e.title_en: A claims fraud demonstration that freezes its results instead of retraining a model on start-up: it loads the team already validated numbers, it says plainly that two of forty-six investigation briefs failed the human rubric and shows those two with their real scores rather than hiding them, and it publishes a no-skill baseline of 0.0597 against a precision-recall area of 0.1945 at a threshold that puts seven and a half percent of claims into review.

e.summary: **Insurance Fraud Detection Demo**（Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`）**是一个**车险理赔舞弊识别的**演示应用****——**逐字自述为**「**insurance fraud detection, risk scoring, and claim analysis**」**。**本次实测**：**Gradio 应用**（**`sdk_version` **6.26.0**、**Python **3.12**）**、**创建 **2026-09-04T23:53:06Z**、**最后修改 **2026-09-05T00:58:19Z**（**⭐ 均在**解冻窗口边界**附近**）**、**likes **0****；**⚠️ 而**其 `*.hf.space` 域名**本次**两次请求**得到**两种状态****：**第一次**返回 **HTTP 206** 与**平台页**「**Preparing Space**」**，**第二次**返回 **HTTP 200** 并**取到真实应用页****（**页面标题逐字为**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**）**——**⭐ 而其运行档位逐字为 **`zero-a10g`**（**缩容到零**）**，**故**「**Preparing**」**正是**冷启动**那一瞬**；**⭐ 本词条**把两次请求**并列记录**、**不调和**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**不现场重训**，**而**把**已冻结的结果**端出来**（**⭐ 逐字见下**）**；**② **46 份调查简报里**2 份没通过人工评分标准**，**而**它**照原分数显示**——**⭐ 逐字**「**the 2 that didn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t are shown with their real score, not hidden**」**；**③ **它**同时给出**「**无技能基线**」（**`no_skill_pr_auc` **0.0597**）与**验证集／**测试集的**落差**（**PR-AUC 差 **0.0251**、**召回差 **0.0627**）**，**并**另做一次**跨年份稳健性检查**（**用 **1994–1995** 训练、**只在 **1996** 上评一次**，**并逐字声明**「**Not calibrated, not thresholded, not the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s final model**」**）**；**④ **操作阈值 **0.15**，**对应**抽查工时占比 **7.61%**、**高／**中／**低三档的风险分层**逐档给出**案量与**实际舞弊率**。**⚠️ 本次**未启动该 Space、**未调用其界面**。
e.summary_hk: **Insurance Fraud Detection Demo**（Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`）**是一個**車險理賠舞弊識別的**演示應用****——**逐字自述為**「**insurance fraud detection, risk scoring, and claim analysis**」**。**本次實測**：**Gradio 應用**（**`sdk_version` 6.26.0**、**Python 3.12**）**、**創建 2026-09-04T23:53:06Z**、**最後修改 2026-09-05T00:58:19Z**、**likes 0****；**⚠️ 而**其 `*.hf.space` 域名**本次兩次請求**得到**兩種狀態****：**第一次**返回 HTTP 206 與**平台頁**「**Preparing Space**」**，**第二次**返回 HTTP 200 並**取到真實應用頁****（**標題逐字為**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**）**——**⭐ 其檔位逐字為 `zero-a10g`（**縮容到零**）**，**故**「**Preparing**」**正是**冷啟動那一瞬**；**⭐ 並列記錄**、**不調和**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**能跑的应用：一個 Space 的四種活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **它不現場重訓**，**而**把**已凍結的結果**端出來**；**② **46 份調查簡報裡**2 份沒通過人工評分標準**，**而**它**照原分數顯示、**不藏起來****；**③ **它同時給出**「**無技能基線**」（**`no_skill_pr_auc` 0.0597**）與**驗證集／**測試集的落差**（**PR-AUC 差 0.0251**、**召回差 0.0627**）**，**並**另做一次**跨年份穩健性檢查**（**用 1994–1995 訓練、**只在 1996 上評一次**，**並逐字聲明**「**Not calibrated, not thresholded, not the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s final model**」**）**；**④ **操作閾值 0.15**，**對應**抽查工時佔比 7.61%**，**並**逐檔給出**高／**中／**低三檔的案量與**實際舞弊率****。**⚠️ 本次**未啟動該 Space、**未調用其介面**。
e.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a demonstration application for vehicle claim fraud detection**, described verbatim as covering insurance fraud detection, risk scoring and claim analysis. **Measured this round**: a Gradio application on a recent runtime, created and last modified within hours of each other in early September, with no likes, and **its subdomain answered two probes differently, first with a platform page stating that the Space is still preparing and then with the real application, whose page title names a claim fraud intelligence console, while its hardware tier is a scale-to-zero one, so the preparing page was a cold start, both probes being recorded here side by side**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: it does not retrain a model on start-up but serves already frozen results; of forty-six investigation briefs two failed the human rubric and those two are shown with their real scores rather than hidden; it publishes both a no-skill baseline of about six percent against a precision-recall area of about nineteen percent and the gap between its validation and test splits, together with a separate cross-year robustness check that is explicitly labelled as neither calibrated nor thresholded nor the final model; and it states an operating threshold that puts about seven and a half percent of claims into review, with risk tiers reporting their own case volumes and real fraud rates.** **The Space was not started and its interface was not called this round.**
e.body:
**Insurance Fraud Detection Demo**（Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`）**是一个**车险理赔舞弊识别的**演示应用****——**逐字自述为**「**insurance fraud detection, risk scoring, and claim analysis**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**不现场重训模型**，**而是**把已冻结的结果端出来**——**`model_pipeline.py` 抬头逐字为**「**PRECOMPUTED-RESULTS BACKEND (demo viewer)**」**，**并逐字说明**「**Instead of retraining on start-up, it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**⭐ 即**很多**演示**会在**启动时**现场重训**一个模型**（**于是**每次看到的数字**都不一样**）**，**而**它**反过来**——**把**已经验证过的那一套**（**模型、**风险分层、**SHAP 驱动因素与**生成式摘要**）**冻结**下来**端给读者**。**⭐⭐ ② 它**写明了为什么必须这样做**，**而**理由里点出一个**具体的失败模式****——**逐字为**「**Why: the demo must show the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s REAL reported results**」**，**即**「**the finalized XGBoost + isotonic-calibration model (test PR-AUC 0.195), its real risk tiers, real SHAP drivers, and the real Qwen2.5 briefs the team generated and scored**」**，**并逐字否定另一种做法**：**「**not a fresh model retrained live (which would produce different numbers and could silently run on synthetic fallback data)**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**括号里那半句最值得抄**：**⭐ 即**现场重训**不仅**会给出**不同的数字**，**还**可能**在**无人察觉的情况下**回落到**合成数据**上**——**⭐ 这**正是**「**演示看起来在跑**」**与**「**演示在跑真东西**」**之间的**差别**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 46 份调查简报里**2 份没通过人工评分标准**，**而**它**照原分数显示**——**逐字为**「**it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results from `demo_data.json` (46 investigation briefs spanning Low/Medium/High risk tiers, 44 of which passed the human rubric - the 2 that didn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t are shown with their real score, not hidden)**」**；**⭐ 另一处**数据文件的说明也逐字给出同样的事实**：**「**All 46 SHAP+brief samples across Low/Medium/High risk tiers (High=30, Medium=8, Low=8); 44/46 passed human rubric review (95.7%, mean 7.83/8). Real validated results.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处是本条的**教学核心**：**⭐ 即**一个**演示**主动**保留**那**两份没通过的样本**，**并**标明**它们的真实分数**——**⭐ 而不是**只**挑出**通过的那 44 份**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这正是**「**公布结果时**要不要**把不通过的样本一起公布**」**这一问题的**一个具体答案**。**⭐⭐ ④ 指标给全了，**含**失败的上限与**落差****——**`results/metrics.json` 本次实测逐字含**：**测试集 **2,313 笔索赔**、**舞弊率 **5.97%**；**⭐ **「**无技能基线**」**逐字为** `no_skill_pr_auc` **0.0597**（**⭐ 即**不做任何模型时**PR-AUC 大约就是**这个数**）**；**PR-AUC **0.1945**、**召回 **0.2899**、**精确率 **0.2273**、**macro-F1 **0.6003**、**MCC **0.2031**、**ROC-AUC **0.8297**、**Brier **0.0515**；**操作阈值逐字为 **0.15**，**对应**混淆矩阵四格**为 **TP 40／**FP 136／**FN 98／**TN 2,039**，**「**抽查工时占比**」逐字为 `caseload_pct` **7.61%**；**⭐ 风险分层逐档给出**：**Low **1,573 笔／**占 **68.01%／**实际舞弊率 **1.78%**、**Medium **564 笔／**24.38%／**12.41%**、**High **176 笔／**7.61%／**22.73%****；**⭐ 校准方法逐字为 **`isotonic`**；**⭐ 且**另给**验证集与**测试集的**落差**（**`pr_auc_gap` **0.0251**、**`recall_gap` **0.0627**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组数字**说明**它**把**「**上线后会多忙**」（**抽查 7.61%**）与**「**每一档里实际有多少舞弊**」**都**摊开了**——**⭐ 而不是**只报一个 **ROC-AUC**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 一次**跨年份稳健性检查**，**并**自带免责说明****——**逐字为**「**Same model recipe as best_model_config.json, retrained from scratch on 1994-95 only, evaluated once on 1996 only. Not calibrated, not thresholded, not the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s final model.**」**，**并给出**训练年份 **1994–1995**、**测试年份 **1996**、**训练舞弊率 **6.26%／**测试舞弊率 **5.22%** 与**该次检查的指标**（**PR-AUC **0.1157**、**ROC-AUC **0.7343** 等**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一节值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**它**做了一次**「**换年份**」的**压力测试**，**并**明确说**这不是**最终模型**、**没校准、**没定阈值**——**⭐ 故**读者**不会**把**这次较差的结果**误当成**项目主张的**性能**。**⭐ 模型来源亦逐字写明**（**`source_model`：**`XGBoost`、**平衡策略 **`class_weight`、**Optuna 第 **58** 次试验**）**，**并给出**随机种子 **42** 与**生成时间 **2026-08-29****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 四处**须如实标注**：**① **它的 README **是**平台模板**（**逐字只有**「**Check out the configuration reference at https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/spaces-config-reference**」**一行**）**——**⭐ 即**本条目里**所有实质内容**都来自**代码与**指标文件**，**而**不是**来自**作者写的说明**；**② **本次**对**其线上域名**做了**两次请求**，**得到**两种状态****：**第一次 **HTTP 206** 与**平台页**「**Preparing Space**」**，**第二次 **HTTP 200**、**19,576 字节**，**页面标题逐字为**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**（**并含**「**Use via API**」与**「**Built with Gradio**」**）**——**⭐ 而**其运行档位逐字为 **`zero-a10g`**（**缩容到零的 GPU 档**）**，**故**第一次看到的**「**Preparing**」**正是**冷启动**；**⭐ 本词条**并列记录**、**不调和**；**③ **仓库里有**两张带同一品牌名的图**（**`innovexa_header_mark.png` 与 **`innovexa_logo.png`**）**——**⭐ 本词条**只记录**这一事实**，**不推测**该名称**属于**哪个主体**；**④ **未核实**其训练数据**来源**（**⭐ 只知**年份覆盖 **1994–1996**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]、**[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、**[[claim-fraud-dataset-generator]]、**[[explainable-ai-fraud]]、**[[friction-ledger-claimwatch]]、**[[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 覆盖**舞弊识别与**风险评分**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一个**冻结结果、**并**公开未通过样本**的**在线理赔舞弊演示**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **演示要**端**验证过的数字**，**不要**现场重训**（**否则**你展示的**不是**你的模型**）**；**② **没通过评分标准的样本**也要**留下**，**并**标明**它们的真实分数**；**③ **除了 **ROC-AUC**，**还要报**「**会带来多少工作量**」**（**⭐ 本条为 **7.61%**）与**「**每一档的**实际命中率**」**；**④ **任何**一次性的稳健性检查**都要**自带**「**这不是最终模型**」**的说明**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有启动该 Space、**没有调用其界面**（**未提交任何索赔、**未得到任何舞弊评分**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能可用**、**不主张**其任何指标的**可复现性**。**② ⚠️ **README 为平台模板**——**⭐ 故**本条目**对项目目的的描述**来自**代码内的说明文字**，**而**不是**来自**作者面向读者的**文档**；**⭐ 这一处**须由读者自行复核**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**训练数据的来源与许可**（**⭐ 只知**年份跨 **1994–1996**、**规模 **2,313 笔测试索赔**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**人工评分标准**（**`human rubric`**）的**具体条目与**评分人**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**两张品牌图片**所对应的主体**（**⭐ 本词条**不做此类推测**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该 Space **创建于 **2026-09-04T23:53:06Z**、**最后修改 **2026-09-05T00:58:19Z**——**⭐ 恰好**落在**解冻窗口的边界**附近**（**按**跨日时间**属**边界之外）**；**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**演示端出**冻结结果**、**并**公开未通过人工评分标准的样本**」这一形态**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用**是**演示**，**其风险分**不构成**任何舞弊认定**，**也不得**用于**拒赔或**调查决定**。
e.body_hk:
**Insurance Fraud Detection Demo**（Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`）**是一個**車險理賠舞弊識別的**演示應用****——**逐字自述為**「**insurance fraud detection, risk scoring, and claim analysis**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**能跑的应用：一個 Space 的四種活法**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Hugging Face API、倉庫檔案與一次真實請求實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它不現場重訓模型**，**而是把已凍結的結果端出來**——**`model_pipeline.py` 抬頭逐字為**「**PRECOMPUTED-RESULTS BACKEND (demo viewer)**」**，**並逐字說明**「**Instead of retraining on start-up, it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results**」**。**⭐ 很多演示會**在啟動時**現場重訓一個模型**（**每次數字都不同**）**，**而它反過來**——**把**已驗證的那一套**（**模型、**風險分層、**SHAP 驅動因素與**生成式摘要**）**凍結下來端給讀者**。**⭐⭐ ② 它寫明為什麼必須這樣做**，**並點出一個具體失敗模式**——**逐字為**「**not a fresh model retrained live (which would produce different numbers and could silently run on synthetic fallback data)**」**。**⭐ 括號裡那半句最值得抄**：**⭐ 即**現場重訓**不僅會給出**不同數字**，**還可能在無人察覺下**回落到**合成數據**上**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 46 份調查簡報裡 2 份沒通過人工評分標準**，**而它照原分數顯示**——**逐字為**「**46 investigation briefs spanning Low/Medium/High risk tiers, 44 of which passed the human rubric - the 2 that didn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t are shown with their real score, not hidden)**」**；**⭐ 數據檔說明亦逐字給出**：**「**All 46 SHAP+brief samples across Low/Medium/High risk tiers (High=30, Medium=8, Low=8); 44/46 passed human rubric review (95.7%, mean 7.83/8). This Hugging Face Space **is a demonstration application for vehicle claim fraud detection**, described verbatim as covering insurance fraud detection, risk scoring and claim analysis. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, it does not retrain a model at start-up but serves already frozen results.** The module that drives the interface is headed with the words precomputed-results backend and states verbatim that instead of retraining on start-up it loads the team already validated results. **That is the point most worth recording: many demonstrations retrain a model live, so the numbers change on every visit, whereas this one freezes the validated set — the finalised model, its real risk tiers, its real explanation drivers and the generated briefs the team scored — and serves that instead.** **Second, it states why, and the reason names a specific failure mode**: the demonstration must show the project real reported results, meaning the finalised gradient-boosted model with isotonic calibration at a test precision-recall area of about nineteen percent, its real risk tiers, real explanation drivers and real generated briefs, and **not a fresh model retrained live, which the note says would produce different numbers and could silently run on synthetic fallback data.** **That parenthetical is the sentence to copy: retraining live not only yields different numbers but can quietly fall back to synthetic data without anyone noticing, which is exactly the difference between a demonstration that looks like it is running and one that is running the real thing.** **Third, of forty-six investigation briefs two failed the human rubric and those two are shown with their real scores rather than hidden**, the data file repeating the same fact that all forty-six samples span the three risk tiers, that forty-four of forty-six passed human rubric review at a mean of seven point eight three out of eight, and that these are real validated results. **That is the teaching core of this entry: a demonstration that keeps the two samples that failed and labels their real scores, instead of presenting only the forty-four that passed, which is a concrete answer to the question of whether failures belong in a published result.** **Fourth, the metrics are complete and include both the floor and the gaps.** The test set holds two thousand three hundred and thirteen claims at a fraud rate of about six percent; the no-skill baseline for the precision-recall area is about six percent as well; the model reaches a precision-recall area of about nineteen percent, recall of about twenty-nine percent, precision of about twenty-three percent, a macro F1 of about sixty percent, a Matthews correlation of about twenty percent, a ROC area of about eighty-three percent and a Brier score of about five percent. **The operating threshold is stated as a single number, with the confusion matrix giving forty true positives, one hundred and thirty-six false positives, ninety-eight false negatives and two thousand and thirty-nine true negatives, and with the share of claims routed to review stated as about seven and a half percent. The risk tiers each report their own case volume and real fraud rate, the calibration method is named as isotonic, and the gap between the validation and test splits is given as well.** **Together those numbers answer both how busy the team will be and how much fraud each tier actually contains, rather than reporting a single ROC area.** **Fifth, a cross-year robustness check is included with its own disclaimer**: the same recipe retrained from scratch on two years of data and evaluated once on the following year, explicitly marked as not calibrated, not thresholded and not the project final model, with the training and test fraud rates and that check own weaker metrics given alongside. **That is worth recording separately because a reader is thereby prevented from mistaking the weaker one-off result for the performance the project claims.** The model source is named as a gradient-boosted tree with class weighting at a specific tuning trial, with the random seed and generation date also given. **Sixth, four points must be stated plainly**: the readme is the platform template, containing only the configuration reference line, **so everything of substance in this entry comes from the code and the metrics file rather than from author-written documentation**; the subdomain answered two probes differently this round, the first returning a platform page stating that the Space is still preparing and the second returning the real application whose page title names a claim fraud intelligence console, **while its hardware tier is a scale-to-zero GPU tier, so the preparing page was a cold start; this entry records both probes side by side and does not reconcile them**; the repository carries two images bearing the same brand name, a fact this entry records without speculating about which entity that name belongs to; and the provenance and licensing of the training data were not verified beyond the years it spans. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover fraud guarding, fraud risk scoring, a fraud dataset generator, explainable fraud detection, a claims watch ledger and conformal fraud methods, **while this entry supplies an online claim fraud demonstration that serves frozen results and publishes the samples that failed human review. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: serve validated numbers instead of retraining live, because otherwise what you show is not your model; keep the samples that failed the rubric and label their real scores; report the workload a threshold creates and the real hit rate inside each tier, not only a ROC area; and attach the statement that a one-off robustness check is not the final model.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the Space was not started and its interface was not called**, so no claim was submitted and no fraud score was produced, **and no claim is made about whether it works or whether its metrics are reproducible**. **Second, the readme is the platform template, so the description of the project purpose here comes from text inside the code rather than from author-facing documentation, and that is a point readers must check themselves.** **Third, the provenance and licence of the training data were not verified**, only the years spanned and the test set size. **Fourth, the specific items and the graders of the human rubric were not verified. Fifth, which entity the two brand images refer to was not verified, and this entry makes no guess.** **Sixth, on the window: the Space was created late on 2026-09-04 and last modified shortly after midnight on 2026-09-05**, which by the day boundary places it just outside the thaw window, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a demonstration that serves frozen results and publishes the samples that failed human review. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the application is a demonstration, that its risk score is not a finding of fraud and that it must not be used for denial or investigation decisions.**
